summary: A 7-step route from N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminide to glyoxylate, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.equation: an N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl derivative + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl derivative + UDP + H(+)

reactions.equation: a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl derivative + GDP-beta-L-fucose = an alpha-L-Fuc-(1->2)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-alpha-D-GalNAc derivative + GDP + H(+)

reactions.equation: a beta-D-galactosyl-(1<->1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GM4 (d18:1(4E)) + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: a ganglioside GQ1c (d18:1(4E)) + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GP1calph...
reactions.equation: a ganglioside GQ1c (d18:1(4E)) + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GP1calpha (d18:1(4E)) + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: glyoxylate dehydrogenase (acylating)
reactions.equation: glyoxylate + NADP(+) + CoA = oxalyl-CoA + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate monooxygenase
reactions.equation: CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + O2 + 2 H(+) = CMP-N-glycoloyl-beta-neuraminate + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O

reactions.name: a ganglioside GD1b + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GT1b + CMP + H(+)
reactions.equation: a ganglioside GD1b + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GT1b + CMP + H(+)

reactions.equation: a ganglioside GD1a + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GT1a + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: N-alkylglycine oxidase
reactions.equation: an N-alkylglycine + O2 + H2O = an alkylamine + glyoxylate + H2O2
